title: Four Haikus remixed from the @gltich Haiku generator https://glitch.com/~haiku-generator by @jonobr1 #poetryport last haiku mine as feedback
summary: The present errand reeking in the tranquil tale is nodding elsewhere The discrete swordfish melting hte keyless cap is flirting northward The jobless retstraint chucking in the quilted ink is owning steeply The secret sophmore mixing in the inverse ink is scaring sparsely No articles please the power of THE tiny in face of real words
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The present errand

reeking in the tranquil tale

is nodding elsewhere

 

The discrete swordfish

melting hte keyless cap

is flirting northward

 

The jobless retstraint

chucking in the quilted ink

is owning steeply

 

The secret sophmore

mixing in the inverse ink

is scaring sparsely

 

No articles please

the power of THE tiny

in face of real words
